why: Merge round for slice 1 of the mock sweep's lib-top plan, in next/ and the lint tooling: origin/main (PRs 1498, 1462, 1515 and 1516) merged into fabrikalfa/mock-lib-top-s1 at 5c6f381e7, merge commit 135df3c1e, with no new law and no new behavior. Six files conflicted, each folded with both sides kept. next/packages/libfabrika/src/Id.ts keeps the branch's generator whole (makeGenerator over SecureRandom, the draw's Effect.catchDefect, the pure advance step, Generator.layer over SecureRandom.layerWebCrypto) in main's namespace imports, with SecureRandom from effect/crypto/SecureRandom as libfabrika imports Digest; main's IdError.make in place of new IdError is applied to the branch's generator body too. Id.test-support.ts, Id.cause.test.ts and Id.types.test.ts take main's namespace imports with the branch's content; Id.cause.test.ts keeps vi removed and the branch's comment, and drops main's comment that pointed at the old Id.ts:198 spy site. oxlint-plugins/builtin-plants.ts keeps both VI_METHODS and TAGGED_ERROR. oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts keeps main's harness (inConfigCopy, globsHolding, refusedIn, textOf, the new plantPath) and the branch's viGlobs; the branch's refusedInEveryFolder helper is gone and its VI_METHODS scenario is rewritten on inConfigCopy with the same coverage checks, the same one-file-per-glob check and the same exact-lines check per file. The branch's plantPath case for a glob by extension is dropped: main's plantPath already answers next/packages/libfabrika/src/*.ts with src/planted.ts and *.tsx with src/planted.tsx, the same paths. Main's L2 law, the root rules and every override that sets no-restricted-properties carry the Data.TaggedError entry, is green on the merged tree, so no entry was added.
